Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000321": As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, Ember team)

- memory_id "1000306" [constraint]: Tomasz holds the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-04-03; page Tomasz for anything Atlas-related, not Priya Raman.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000286": On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000276": The image resizer is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000273" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000266": Lena has the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-03-17, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000259": The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-07.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000246": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-03.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000235": Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-02-27, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000155": The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000118": The indexer is owned by Cinder.  (about: Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
